description: The coast of fnpf_3d_coast_features_mpi2 with dynamic wetting and drying (A 343 2: run-up and run-down on the beach, the island and the headland), 1 rank, 160 steps. Covers the rewetted cells: the column of a rewetted cell takes the surface potential (before it held the potential of the step it dried in, 0 on land, which the cross-derivatives and the bed boundary condition of the wet columns next to it read), and the clamp of wet cells below the criterion from the values before the clamp.
covers: fnpf_fsfbc_wd::wetdry_dynamic: column of a rewetted cell, clamp averages
fnpf_laplace_cds2: cross-derivatives next to a dry column
